timezone_note: All timestamps are UTC. Eastern release times were converted via the IANA America/New_York zone, so DST is already accounted for.
disclaimer: For informational and educational purposes only. Not investment advice. Times are subject to change; verify against official sources before trading.

attribution.fred: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
attribution.treasury: TreasuryDirect auction data is public domain (CC0).
attribution.federal_reserve: FOMC calendar data is a U.S. government work in the public domain.

warnings: macro_releases: upstream has published dates only through 2026-12-31, 240 days short of the window end 2027-08-28. Treat later months as incomplete, not empty.
treasury_auctions: upstream has published dates only through 2026-08-04, 389 days short of the window end 2027-08-28. Treat later months as incomplete, not empty.

events.title: FOMC Meeting Begins (Day 1)
events.note: First day of the two-day FOMC meeting. No statement is released today; the decision comes tomorrow at 2:00pm ET.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 6-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 6-Week Bill closes at 11:30 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 7-Year Note
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 7-Year Note closes at 13:00 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 17-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 17-Week Bill closes at 11:30 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 2-Year Note
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 2-Year Note closes at 11:30 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: FOMC Statement & Rate Decision
events.note: Interest rate decision and policy statement released at 2:00pm ET. Expect a sharp repricing in index futures on the release and again during the 2:30pm press conference.

events.title: FOMC Chair Press Conference
events.note: Chair's press conference begins at 2:30pm ET. The Q&A regularly moves markets more than the statement itself. Not yet confirmed on the Fed's calendar; a presser has followed every meeting since 2019.

events.title: GDP (Advance Estimate)
events.note: First (advance) estimate of quarterly GDP from the BEA. The advance print is the market-moving one -- it is the first read on the quarter.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Initial Jobless Claims
events.note: Weekly initial and continuing unemployment claims, released every Thursday at 8:30am ET. The highest-frequency read on the labour market; the four-week average is what traders watch for a trend.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Personal Income & Outlays (PCE)
events.note: BEA report containing core PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Watched closely into FOMC meetings.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 4-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 4-Week Bill closes at 11:30 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 8-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 8-Week Bill closes at 11:30 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (estimated)
events.note: Purchasing managers' index for manufacturing, normally released on the first business day of the month at 10:00am ET. A sub-50 print reads as contraction. Date is estimated from ISM's usual pattern -- confirm against ism.ws before trading it.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 13-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 13-Week Bill closes at 13:00 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 26-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 26-Week Bill closes at 13:00 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Factory Orders (M3)
events.note: Census Bureau M3 survey: shipments, inventories and new orders for manufactured goods, released at 10:00am ET. Core capital goods orders are read as a proxy for business investment intentions. The advance durable goods report precedes this by a few days.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: JOLTS Job Openings
events.note: BLS survey of job openings, hires and quits, released at 10:00am ET -- note the later time than most BLS releases. The openings-to-unemployed ratio is a labour-market tightness gauge the Fed cites.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 6-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 6-Week Bill closes at 13:00 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Auction: 52-Week Bill
events.note: Competitive bidding for the 52-Week Bill closes at 13:00 ET. A weak auction (low bid-to-cover, high tail) pushes yields up and typically pressures index futures.

events.title: Treasury Quarterly Refunding Announcement
events.note: Treasury announces the size and composition of the coming quarter's coupon auctions at 8:30am ET. Changes to long-end issuance move yields and, through them, equity futures. Computed as the first Wednesday of Feb/May/Aug/Nov -- verify against Treasury's press release schedule.

events.title: ISM Services PMI (estimated)
events.note: Purchasing managers' index for services, normally released on the third business day of the month at 10:00am ET. Services are the bulk of the US economy, so this often outweighs the manufacturing print. Date is estimated -- confirm against ism.ws before trading it.

events.note: Interest rate decision and policy statement released at 2:00pm ET. Expect a sharp repricing in index futures on the release and again during the 2:30pm press conference.

events.title: FOMC Chair Press Conference
events.note: Chair's press conference begins at 2:30pm ET. The Q&A regularly moves markets more than the statement itself. Not yet confirmed on the Fed's calendar; a presser has followed every meeting since 2019.

events.title: Futures Liquidity Roll (/ES, /NQ, /MES, /MNQ) → Z6 back month
events.note: Volume and open interest migrate to the back-month contract around this date (the second Thursday before the third Friday). Quote the back month from here on, and expect wider spreads in the front month.

events.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
events.note: Headline and core consumer inflation from the BLS. The core month-over-month print drives the immediate rates and equity reaction.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Initial Jobless Claims
events.note: Weekly initial and continuing unemployment claims, released every Thursday at 8:30am ET. The highest-frequency read on the labour market; the four-week average is what traders watch for a trend.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: CME Official Roll Date (/ES, /NQ, /MES, /MNQ)
events.note: CME's stated roll date for equity index products: the Monday prior to the third Friday. Most traders have already rolled by now -- see the liquidity roll the preceding Thursday.

events.title: Producer Price Index (PPI)
events.note: Wholesale/producer inflation from the BLS. Watched as a lead-in to CPI and for the PPI components that feed the PCE calculation.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Retail Sales (Advance)
events.note: Census Bureau advance estimate of monthly retail and food service sales. Consumer spending is roughly two-thirds of GDP, so the control-group figure moves growth expectations and index futures.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Futures Expiration (/ES, /NQ, /MES, /MNQ) — Z6
events.note: Front-month contract expires, settling to the Special Opening Quotation at the 9:30am ET cash open.

events.title: Quad Witching
events.note: Index futures, index options, single-stock options and single-stock futures all expire. Expect elevated volume all session and a large closing auction.

events.title: GDP (Third Estimate)
events.note: Third estimate of quarterly GDP. The quarter is three months stale by now; this rarely moves index futures.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Personal Income & Outlays (PCE)
events.note: BEA report containing core PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Watched closely into FOMC meetings.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: Factory Orders (M3)
events.note: Census Bureau M3 survey: shipments, inventories and new orders for manufactured goods, released at 10:00am ET. Core capital goods orders are read as a proxy for business investment intentions. The advance durable goods report precedes this by a few days.
events.attribution: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

events.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (estimated)
events.note: Purchasing managers' index for manufacturing, normally released on the first business day of the month at 10:00am ET. A sub-50 print reads as contraction. Date is estimated from ISM's usual pattern -- confirm against ism.ws before trading it.
